preservedResponsibilities: Writes represented Writer body text, character decoration/position, source-escaped hyperlink URL fields spanning character-run changes with optional target frame but source-omitted hyperlink name, point bookmarks, paragraph alignment/indentation and native default tab distance, initial physical page properties and direct later paragraph/table page-style section transitions with page-number restart, follow-page suppression and source physical-geometry plausibility for first/follow page chains; splits text at document-owned soft page positions only when a distinct follow section is needed while retaining hints, hyperlinks and bookmarks, paragraph style references, table alignment/left offset/cell boundaries, row height/split and direct cell vertical orientation/border/padding controls derived from native items, plus list definitions including source-mapped level numbering formats, starts, bullet glyphs and paragraph listtext as RTF; uncounted paragraphs omit list controls.
Builds the source sixteen-color Word palette before represented document colors and preserves native underline-color indices in the RTF color table.

Visits native character-hint boundaries without UI coalescing and passes effective SfxItemSet values into RTF attribute emission; invisible auto-kerning differences retain their native run boundaries, hyperlinks and point bookmarks.

RTF run collection now borrows actual SwAttrIter/CharFormat item stacks for named and automatic hints. Every represented script font is registered before the font table is serialized; style and run property modes are distinguished. The source RTLAndCJKState consumer is exposed, but complete native MSWord script/bidi production, full font identity/encoding and parser language mapping remain unverified.

Native non-associated OutputCharFontAssoc updates the actual RtfExport current encoding through FontMapExport and checked font charset selection, with original unknown-to-default fallback; associated font output leaves encoding unchanged. Native RunText ignores its supplied charset and delegates RawText/OutString using current export encoding. RTF text uses represented GetSnippet substitutions; style names and hyperlink values use OutString.

The name-only Map font table is replaced by wwFontHelper with native FFN identity, preserving different metadata for equal family names. The actual export stream is used for native font-table methods and final byte writes; TextEncoder no longer owns RTF byte output. Source InitFontTable seed/order/default and automatic-style usage enumeration remain pending.

S3HW1E InitFontTable integration: RtfExport now derives from the actual shared MSWordExportBase with real document/current/original range owners, sets original m_bLoadAllFonts=true and m_bSubstituteBullets=false, and initializes its genuine font helper before serialization. Original seeds/global western default/document western user default, western/CJK/CTL ForEachCharacterFontItem(false) order and used-list bullet/bitmap font collection replace the RTF run/style pre-registration loop. Native lazy used numbering snapshots keep document order and append the actual unused outline pointer. Native bullet preparation copies VCL values before MaybeAskConfig, preserves family before substitution and uses original nine-level/continuous-one bounds (WRITER196). Original RTF header uses the effective default-font ID and adeflang1025 instead of hard-coded deff0; redundant non-source ansicpg1252 was removed. Existing complete-body callers and shell retain an explicit WriteDocument bridge that creates/releases genuine temporary SwPaM/SwPosition owners; no synthetic document DTO or optional uninitialized native context is added. Original enabled MS bullet conversion is implemented through StarSymbolToMSMultiFont, while RTF keeps its no-op branch. The fixed native converter constructor/tables/find/factory match all65536 UTF16 inputs under ASan/UBSan; duplicate-node tree lookup follows the measured native standard-library binding (WRITER197), not a first-preference correction. This does not certify the full SAL/VCL/Writer ABI, cross-standard-library selection identity, complete export traversal, binary/DOCX output, or remaining filter/default/HTML/history obligations. Registered browser file UI/autosave/recovery deviations are unchanged.

S3HW1E RTF numbering-table integration: actual GetNumberingId pointer identity and the InitFontTable used-rule snapshot replace the separate name-keyed RTF list map. Original abstract/instance loops emit nine Word levels or one continuous level, including the actual outline owner. Source level preparation preserves ListFormat UTF16 placeholders, separator suppression, unsupported level10 handling, unsigned-byte positions and signed16 geometry; RtfAttributeOutput writes original NFC/CJK-language, alignment, start, legal, follow, font/character properties and destinations. The browser command-rule assembler now supplies level-specific ListFormat instead of creating deprecated patternless numeric levels. Original character color/underline visitors run before header serialization to admit numbering-style colors; native accumulated automatic-style vector order and shared-handle release are preserved. New owned item sets are disposed. WRITER198 records retained adjacent separators. Common numbering preparation is currently bound to the actual RTF virtual output; full common AttributeOutputBase/DOCX numbering, graphic brush ownership, paragraph numbering/restart temporary-rule lifetimes, character-style table/cache and complete OutColorTable responsibilities remain unverified. This source-bound focused integration does not certify full upstream parity or filter completeness.

S3HW1E temporary numbering ownership: SwNumFormat logical destruction releases actual SwClient registration; reference replacement and null-pointer Set now dispose the old owner. SwNumRule binds the document name index, disposes owned levels/current-name map entry/client containers, and retains original unsigned16 first/last-rule ownership of four lazily initialized base families. Effective base formats use the same protected const reference and shipped GetBulletChar resolver. Document teardown releases its actual rule table through the existing aggregate/list-manager binding. MSWordExportBase destroys only its temporary tail after dropping borrowed document entries. Source DuplicateNumRuleImpl builds a fresh legacy-mode NUM_RULE with source defaults, copies all ten effective formats, keeps it outside the document and uses the original unsigned16 post-increment prefix; DuplicateNumRule changes one unsigned16 start and releases its temporary format. The native default automatic-name overload now consumes a preferred name and source prefix-parse/flag logic rather than ignoring the argument. Browser RNG replaces platform RNG; mail-merge/environment-stable and nonautomatic naming branches have no admitted caller. Full-document RTF and test bridges release actual exporter ownership before ranges/documents. WRITER200 records retained counter widths. Tests check shared-base lifetimes, replacement/reset/client teardown, map erase semantics, default metadata, all ten levels, preferred-name collisions, and document-vs-export ownership. This prepares original paragraph restart dispatch; it is not yet wired into ParaNumRule and does not certify full Writer lifetime/ABI, paragraph/style-cache/importer completeness or source ownership location equivalence of the existing browser aggregate.
omittedResponsibilities: Full page-style chain/section geometry semantics, later-section import, frames, pictures, non-hyperlink fields, headers/footers, drawings and full style-property export paths remain unverified.
